results.rationale: Consistency: plug, housing silhouette and cable remain; wood texture and port types/labels change beyond changing the count. Instruction: ten USB sockets become four elongated slots and two round marks, not six recognizable USB interfaces; major omission. Quality: coherent overall charger and plug, but misshapen port interiors and ambiguous tiny labels are noticeable defects.

Consistency: the open book becomes closed, while vase and table contours shift slightly; pale setting and flower colors remain. Instruction: book remains right of vase instead of moving to the opposite left side; non-compliance. Quality: coherent closed book, glass tabletop, reflections and flowers with no noticeable artifacts.
